facts.text: Odebolt Museum, the Iowa Rural Schools Museum, Peterson Pioneer Home, and historic bank building offer a wealth of local history.
Odebolt’s name comes from Odebolt Creek, though the creek’s name origin is disputed between a French fur trapper and a bolt falling in the water.
A one-room house once inhabited by Swedish immigrants now displays antiques and artifacts, showcasing early immigrant life.
The historic bank building on Main Street, between 1st and 2nd Streets, houses a small history room with Adams banking and ranch stories.
Odebolt Museum showcases military history, a 1900s kitchen, a barbershop, hospital equipment, school memorabilia, and local artifacts.
